outcome: Transfusion of 4 or more units of packed red blood cells
cohort: Patients who delivered at a tertiary referral university hospital by lower uterine cesarean section with non-adherent placenta previa, over a 10-year period.
finding: Patients with non-adherent placenta previa and a history of cesarean section had a higher risk of complications like organ injury, blood transfusions, and hysterectomy.
